name: Dark Hide
description:
The Vibe: Cozy luxury with a modern gourmand twist.

The Scent Journey: Opens with a crisp, refreshing splash of citrus layered over a subtly nutty hint of almond. As it settles, a clean, powdery heart of elegant white florals emerges. The fragrance dries down to a deeply comforting base of rich cacao, warm vanilla, rich amber, and smooth woody notes, all enhanced by a sophisticated touch of warm spice.

Best for :The man who appreciates a smooth, rich, and deeply comforting scent with long-lasting depth.
